throughput_definition: Unique receipts from source cohort, including drain, divided by source-window seconds. Fixed offered load; no capacity sweep.
payload_definition: Application body only; decimal MB. Stereo-pair rows include both pixel buffers. Pair and per-eye rows overlap; do not sum them.
latency_definition: Actual source publication to callback in co-simulation milliseconds. Age starts at scheduled release. Native clocks have 1 ms buckets.

cohorts.historical: 0.2 s source / 0.05 s warmup / 0.15 s drain. Legacy DDS and endpoints; 6 frames per eye; exploratory. No exported pair-age metric.
cohorts.acceptance: 2 s source / 0.25 s warmup / 0.5 s control or 0.75 s stereo drain. Matched endpoints and 16 MiB DDS profile; 60 stereo pairs. One repeat.
